tables.name: newsletter_lists
tables.comments: Mailing list targeting campaigns. Platform-scoped lists have no organization; organization-scoped lists belong to a specific tenant.

tables.name: newsletter_subscribers

fields.name: email
fields.comments: Address as typed by user, used in greetings

fields.name: email_normalized
fields.comments: Lowercased/de-dotted address used for lookup and uniqueness

tables.comments: Subscribers per mailing list. Confirmation and unsubscribe tokens are stored as hashes.

tables.name: newsletter_templates

fields.name: html_override
fields.comments: Custom designer HTML body bypassing block rendering

tables.comments: Reusable campaign templates with pre-configured block layouts or HTML overrides.

tables.name: newsletters
tables.comments: Campaign entities. Contains denormalized counters so admin dashboard queries do not scan recipients table.

tables.name: newsletter_recipients
tables.comments: Per-recipient delivery log for each campaign send. Unique index guarantees idempotent dispatch.

tables.name: newsletter_events

fields.name: url
fields.comments: Destination URL for click tracking events

tables.comments: Append-only raw deliverability and engagement event audit log (opens, clicks, bounces, complaints).

tables.name: users
tables.comments: Platform user account in identity schema
